title: Halves that look different
_map: Halves that look different (Y1). Big idea: a half is 1 of 2 equal parts, whatever it looks like. Creative: cut a square field in half as many different ways as he can.
_story: The robot wants to share a square field between two sheep. It cuts it unfairly first (a sheep complains). Ismaeel finds halves that look completely different but are still fair.
_stepChain: sharing fairly (fair-shares) → cut a field into 2 → an unfair cut: one part bigger → 2 equal parts are called halves → halves can look different: strips, triangles → test: is it 2 equal parts?

talk.goodAnswer: it's one of two equal parts; both parts must be the same size.

talk.ask: Can two halves look different from another pair of halves?
talk.goodAnswer: yes: a square cut down the middle or corner to corner both make halves.

handsOn: Fold a square of paper in half in as many different ways as you can. Are all your halves really halves? How can you check?

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Two sheep need to share this square field. I'll cut it into two parts!

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: There! Oh. One sheep says, that's not fair, your part is bigger! Hmm, it is bigger.
To be fair, both parts must be the same size. When something is cut into 2 equal parts, each part is called a half.
Halves can look different! Cut across the other way. Or corner to corner, making two triangles. They look different, but every time it's 2 equal parts.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Is this a half? I cut it into 2 parts, so it must be a half!

question.prompt: Is the robot's shaded part a half?
question.onRight: Yes, you spotted it. 2 parts isn't enough: they must be 2 equal parts.

0.hint: Look at the sizes. Are the two parts the same?
0.say: There are 2 parts, but one is much bigger. Halves must be 2 equal parts, so this isn't a half.

question.reveal: Not a half. The parts aren't equal.

rule.text: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts.
rule.ask: Can you say what makes something a half? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A half is one of two equal parts. Halves can look different, as long as both parts are the same size.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: can you cut a square into halves with a wiggly line?
bonus.reveal: Yes! If the wiggle is the same on both sides, through the middle, both parts are equal. Halves can be any shape.
